Run a seek back-end that holds provider API keys and proxies CLI calls to providers.

Part of [`seek`](seek.md).

## Usage

```text
seek serve [options]
```

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--host <host>` | Interface to bind (env: SEEK_SERVER_HOST) | `"127.0.0.1"` |
| `--port <port>` | Port to listen on (env: SEEK_SERVER_PORT) | `"8787"` |
| `--no-auth` | Accept requests without a SEEK_SERVER_TOKEN (trusted networks only) |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek serve` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek serve --help`:

```text

Run a seek back-end that holds provider API keys and proxies CLI calls to
providers.

Options:

                 "127.0.0.1")
  --port <port>  Port to listen on (env: SEEK_SERVER_PORT) (default: "8787")
  --no-auth      Accept requests without a SEEK_SERVER_TOKEN (trusted networks
                 only)
  -h, --help     display help for command
```
